meta.badgeText: Illustrative — structural schematic of standard transformer layer operations.

stations.name: Token Input
stations.analogyStation: Loading raw materials onto conveyor belt
stations.details: Converts plain text or ABC score symbols into integer IDs using the vocabulary table from Section 1.

stations.name: Embedding Table
stations.analogyStation: Looking up parts in the master engineering catalogue
stations.details: Replaces each integer ID with an 8-dimensional meaning vector from Section 2.

stations.name: Position Stamp
stations.analogyStation: Stamping sequence numbers onto each cardboard box
stations.details: Since self-attention treats tokens as an unordered set, we add positional numbers so the model distinguishes 'dog bites man' from 'man bites dog'.

stations.name: Multi-Head Attention
stations.analogyStation: Meeting room consultation + adding notes to original folder
stations.details: Tokens communicate across the sequence using Query, Key, and Value arithmetic from Sections 3 and 4. The result is added directly back onto the belt via a residual bypass shortcut.

stations.name: Layer Normalisation
stations.analogyStation: Audio volume limiter keeping levels balanced
stations.details: Scales numbers back to a standardized range (mean 0, variance 1) to keep subsequent layers mathematically stable.

stations.name: Feed-Forward Network
stations.analogyStation: Individual worker desk for private document processing
stations.details: Two neural network layers applied to each token vector separately without sharing information between tokens.

stations.name: Stacked Layers
stations.details: Stacking many blocks lets early layers catch local grammar and rhymes, while deeper layers track global song structures and themes.

stations.name: Logits Projection
stations.details: Multiplies the final token vector against the full vocabulary matrix to produce unnormalized logits for Section 6.
